thought: This is an environmental shot focusing on the regiment HQ interior. The distinctive features are the crude military map on the wall and the flickering oil lamp - these anchor the scene. The setting requires a full view to establish the sparse, makeshift nature of the command post. Lighting is crucial here: dim, dramatic illumination from the single oil lamp creating strong chiaroscuro effects. The visual style calls for realistic, painterly 2D animation with impasto brushwork, desaturated earth tones, and high contrast to convey the gravity and harshness of 1941 wartime conditions.
prompt: Wide-angle environmental shot of a crude regiment command post interior, 1941 Eighth Route Army headquarters. Core focus on a simple hand-drawn military map pinned to rough stone or earthen wall, beside it a single flickering oil lamp casting warm amber light. The setting is a sparse, makeshift room inside either a rustic village house or mountain cave - bare walls showing rough texture of stone or packed earth, minimal furniture consisting of a weathered wooden table with scattered documents and simple wooden stools. Eye-level angle, asymmetrical composition with the military map positioned in the upper third, oil lamp prominent in mid-frame creating the primary light source. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting with the oil lamp providing concentrated warm illumination that creates deep, dancing shadows across the walls and ceiling, leaving corners in near darkness. Strong contrast between the small pool of warm lamplight and the surrounding cold dimness. Solemn, tense, grave atmosphere emphasizing wartime austerity. Desaturated earth-toned color palette dominated by muted ochres, raw umbers, burnt siennas, charcoal grays, with the warm amber of lamplight providing the only saturated color accent. Cool tones in the shadows. Documentary historical realism meets painterly 2D animation aesthetic with visible impasto brushwork texture, thick paint application suggesting weight and gravity. Deep depth of field keeping entire sparse interior sharp and readable. Cinematic, low-key lighting style. Realistic rendering with painterly quality, emphasizing the harsh, austere conditions of wartime mountain warfare. Epic, historical gravitas.
